label: Every first mover moved by none receives its esse in no principle and has no matter and form
paraphrase: Unreceivedness: every first mover moved by none (moves something, moved in no respect) has its esse received in no principle and is not composed of matter and form. A distinct proposition from pure actuality (POTENCY_1 in no respect), from underivedness (firstness: nothing else is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it) and from necessary existence; it asserts no modality and no cause. Derived from the simplicity reading, identity-scoped reception (R3), De ente's receiver-in-receptive-potency reading and receptive irreflexivity.
